from manim import *

class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Proofmotions World", font_size=42, color=YELLOW).to_edge(UP, buff=0.28)
        proof = MathTex(r"\therefore", font_size=34, color=GREEN).move_to([-5.4, 1.0, 0])
        relation = MathTex(r"x+y=z", font_size=30, color=BLUE).move_to([4.9, 1.15, 0])
        congruence = MathTex(
            r"\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF",
            font_size=26,
            color=PURPLE,
        ).move_to([0, -3.0, 0])

        landscape_circle = Circle(
            radius=0.55,
            color=GREEN,
            stroke_width=4,
        ).move_to([-4.8, -1.4, 0])

        landscape_triangle = Polygon(
            [-1.2, -2.1, 0],
            [0, -1.2, 0],
            [1.2, -2.1, 0],
            color=BLUE,
            stroke_width=4,
        )

        pivot = Dot([0, 2.5, 0], radius=0.10, color=YELLOW)

        path = Arc(
            radius=3.5,
            start_angle=PI,
            angle=PI,
            arc_center=[0, 2.5, 0],
            color=TEAL,
            stroke_width=2,
        )

        hero = VGroup(
            Circle(
                radius=0.30,
                color=RED,
                fill_color=RED,
                fill_opacity=1,
            ),
            Circle(
                radius=0.09,
                color=WHITE,
                fill_color=WHITE,
                fill_opacity=1,
            ).shift(UP * 0.08 + LEFT * 0.10),
            Circle(
                radius=0.09,
                color=WHITE,
                fill_color=WHITE,
                fill_opacity=1,
            ).shift(UP * 0.08 + RIGHT * 0.10),
            Line(
                LEFT * 0.20,
                RIGHT * 0.20,
                color=BLACK,
                stroke_width=3,
            ).shift(DOWN * 0.10),
            Line(
                DOWN * 0.28,
                DOWN * 0.65 + LEFT * 0.20,
                color=RED,
                stroke_width=7,
            ),
            Line(
                DOWN * 0.28,
                DOWN * 0.65 + RIGHT * 0.20,
                color=RED,
                stroke_width=7,
            ),
            Line(
                DOWN * 0.38 + LEFT * 0.12,
                DOWN * 0.38 + LEFT * 0.48,
                color=BLUE,
                stroke_width=6,
            ),
            Line(
                DOWN * 0.38 + RIGHT * 0.12,
                DOWN * 0.38 + RIGHT * 0.48,
                color=BLUE,
                stroke_width=6,
            ),
        ).move_to([-3.5, 2.5, 0])

        web = always_redraw(
            lambda: Line(
                pivot.get_center(),
                hero.get_center(),
                color=WHITE,
                stroke_width=4,
            )
        )

        hero_label = Text("Spyder Math", font_size=30, color=RED)
        hero_label.add_updater(
            lambda m: m.next_to(hero, DOWN, buff=0.18)
        )

        trail = TracedPath(
            hero.get_center,
            stroke_color=ORANGE,
            stroke_width=5,
            dissipating_time=1.2,
        )

        launch = Text("LAUNCH", font_size=28, color=ORANGE).move_to(
            [-5.0, 0.9, 0]
        )
        arrival = Text("ARRIVAL", font_size=28, color=GREEN).move_to(
            [5.0, 0.9, 0]
        )

        self.play(
            FadeIn(title),
            FadeIn(proof),
            FadeIn(relation),
            FadeIn(congruence),
            FadeIn(landscape_circle),
            Create(landscape_triangle),
            Create(path),
            run_time=2,
        )

        self.play(
            FadeIn(pivot),
            Create(web),
            FadeIn(hero),
            FadeIn(hero_label),
            FadeIn(launch),
            run_time=2,
        )

        self.play(
            MoveAlongPath(hero, path),
            FadeOut(launch),
            Create(trail),
            run_time=5,
            rate_func=smooth,
        )

        self.play(FadeIn(arrival), run_time=1)
        self.play(Indicate(hero), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.5)
